capabilities: Add, edit, remove, and reorder toolbar buttons bound to any registered command
Choose any built-in Obsidian icon for each button
Adjust button size, spacing, and vertical offset and keep the toolbar above the mobile keyboard
Hide or show the toolbar from settings or the command palette
Preserve command slots when their source plugin is temporarily unavailable
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; README states it runs locally with no network requests or telemetry and includes developer install and release instructions.
problem: Obsidian has no persistent, customizable on-screen toolbar for running commands, especially on mobile where the command palette is cumbersome.

relations.evidence: It works with core commands and commands registered by community plugins, including Ask AI and Todoist-Plug.

summary: A customizable, mobile-friendly command toolbar that runs any registered Obsidian or community-plugin command from persistent buttons.
